sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Tutankhamun ruled the New Kingdom from the age of eight and is believed to have been advised by his stepmother Nefertiti. [w:c:Wikipedia] [Rassimov's Secret]

Rassimov and Harrison Fears travelled to the Tomb of Tutankhamun, having recovered the Key of Nefertiti to open the tomb. Rassimov had a secret agenda, hoping to find the Necklace of Tutankhamun and use it to control the Nullifiers. They were ambushed by the Huntik team who recovered the Necklace from the tomb however they eventually lost the artifact to Rassimov following a battle the Titan of War, Legion. [Rassimov's Secret]

'''Tutankhamun''' was an ancient Egyptian pharaoh and [[Seeker]], and the stepson of [[Nefertiti]]. He possessed a [[Necklace of Tutankhamun|Necklace]] believed to have belonged to [[the Betrayer]] which was buried in his [[Tomb of Tutankhamun|tomb]].

==History==
Tutankhamun ruled the New Kingdom from the age of eight and is believed to have been advised by his stepmother [[Nefertiti]]. {{source|w:c:Wikipedia|Wikipedia}} {{source|Rassimov's Secret}}

[[Rassimov]] and [[Harrison Fears]] travelled to the [[Tomb of Tutankhamun]], having recovered the [[Key of Nefertiti]] to open the tomb. Rassimov had a secret agenda, hoping to find the [[Necklace of Tutankhamun]] and use it to control the [[Nullifiers]]. They were ambushed by the Huntik team who recovered the Necklace from the tomb however they eventually lost the artifact to Rassimov following a battle the [[Titan]] of War, [[Legion]]. {{source|Rassimov's Secret}}
